## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Change type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] CI / supply chain

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm audit --audit-level=high` passes, or findings are explained.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant CLI examples and schemas are validated.

## Security, privacy and evidence

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, customer data or private URLs were added.
- [ ] Trust boundaries and authorization behavior are unchanged or documented.
- [ ] Evidence provenance and methodology-version implications are addressed.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes include threat-model notes and regression tests.

## Documentation and compatibility

- [ ] README or relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] JSON Schemas and compatibility notes are updated where needed.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md is updated.
- [ ] Breaking changes and known limitations are stated.

## Operational impact

Describe any new dependencies, provider integrations, network access, hosting requirements or cost implications.

## Evidence

List commands run and relevant test output.
